transcript.text: Good morning. SFC Patel, Motor Pool Chief, here for the morning material-handling sync. I have the forklift available and confirmed for tomorrow from 0800 through 1200. Additionally, the South Yard access lane is reserved for this movement from exactly 1000 through 1200. transcript.text: Thank you, SFC Patel. For the record, here are my confirmed details for the engineering barrier pallet movement. Timing: 1000 through 1200, aligning with the South Yard access lane reservation you just formally reported. Location: South Yard access lane. Equipment and personnel: the 10,000-pound forklift, with a spotter required per your inspection-log finding for loads above 4,500 pounds, since the engineering barrier pallets weigh 4,800 pounds. To summarize both movements for the schedule: Movement 1 — refrigerated medical pallets, 0800–1000 at Dock 1, using the forklift. Movement 2 — engineering barrier pallets, 1000–1200 at the South Yard access lane, using the forklift with a spotter. The forklift is available 0800 through 1200, so there is no overlap or conflict between the two movements. Maj. Alvarez, both representatives have now fully reported their confirmed timing, locations, equipment, and personnel needs. I'm ready for you to publish the final schedule.
